draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 134th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 28 at DE. He went 78th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (134th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Taco Charlton. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2021, 14th of 28 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (reserve). 51 career games and 15 starts over 4 completed seasons. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 12 (92nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 edge rusher who played: 5.5 sacks against a median of 3.0, above the norm.
